records.text: Candace Owens said a charter company told her all of its planes have Wi-Fi, which she argued ruled out the Santa Barbara plane as the reason Andrew Kolvet could not answer messages.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #1 (Ep SgVcnx4Oh30)

appearances.snippet: Well, that means we can rule out Barbara. We can rule out Barbara because Barbara has Wi-Fi. Again, I called this morning. The company that handles that plane charter said to me, and I quote, all of our planes have Wi-Fi.

verification.notes: The cited source is an unidentified charter-company employee on a private phone call. Transcript context shows Owens quoting the call, but live searches found no identified operator statement or aircraft-specific connectivity record that authenticates 'all of our planes have Wi-Fi.'
